name: Registan and Centre
tagline: Monumental core around the famous square
description: The tourist heart around the Registan ensemble, with the great madrasas, Bibi-Khanym mosque and nearby bazaar. Walkable and full of hotels, restaurants and sights, it is the most convenient base for visitors, though prices and crowds peak near the monuments.
bestFor: Travellers wanting the main monuments and hotels within walking distance

name: Siab and Old City
description: The old residential quarter around Siab Bazaar and the Shah-i-Zinda necropolis, a maze of traditional mahalla lanes and family homes. It offers an authentic, local atmosphere with the city's biggest market nearby, quieter and cheaper than the monument core.
bestFor: Culture seekers wanting authentic mahalla life and the main bazaar

name: Boulevard and Sabir Rahimov
description: The Soviet-era new town southwest of the centre, laid out with wide tree-lined avenues, parks, cafes and the University Boulevard. It has modern apartments, shops and a relaxed local feel, well connected to the centre and popular for evening strolls.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting parks, cafes and modern apartments near the centre

name: University Area
description: The area around Samarkand State University and university boulevard, southwest of the centre, with a younger student population, budget eateries, bookshops and hostels. Lively and affordable in term time, it is a practical base with everyday amenities and good transport links.
bestFor: Budget nomads wanting cheap eats, hostels and a lively student scene
